faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 204DTD Ingenium diesel in the Land Rover Discovery 5. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a 204DTA engine replace a 204DTD in my Discovery 5?
faqs.a: Not always directly. The two versions can differ in calibration, emissions equipment and ancillaries, so we check your VIN and engine code before recommending a compatible replacement for your Discovery 5.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 204DTD engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a 204DTD engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 5 204DTD engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a DPF, turbo or AdBlue component, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204DTD engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 2.0 Ingenium engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 204DTD engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 204DTD?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 5 guide the right decision. EGR, DPF, turbo and AdBlue faults are often repairable on their own. If chain failure has damaged the valves or oil dilution has worn the bearings, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTD engine replacement is usually the better option.
paragraphs: A replacement engine will only last if its supporting systems are healthy. Where relevant, we inspect the DPF, EGR valve and cooler, turbo, intercooler, AdBlue system and cooling circuit, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 5 204DTD Faults
engineProblems.description: This Ingenium diesel usually gives early warnings, and prompt checks can save a much bigger repair.

cards.title: Timing Drive Noise at Cold Start
cards.description: A rattle in the first seconds after starting, timing fault codes or rough running may indicate a stretched timing chain or worn tensioner at the rear. We measure chain stretch and check timing.

cards.title: Diesel in the Engine Oil
cards.description: An oil level climbing between services or a diluted oil warning may come from fuel entering the sump during incomplete DPF regenerations. We check oil condition and driving patterns.

cards.title: Blocked Particulate Filter
cards.description: DPF warnings, limp mode or repeated regeneration attempts may follow short journeys, sensor faults or EGR problems that stop the filter clearing. We read soot data and assess the filter.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Sticking EGR Valve
cards.description: Hesitation, rough idle or EGR fault codes can result from carbon build-up in the EGR valve or cooler, or a leak inside the cooler. We test EGR operation and inspect for leaks.

cards.title: Variable-Vane Turbo Faults
cards.description: A lack of boost, whistling or overboost and underboost codes may point to sticking turbocharger vanes, actuator faults or split intake hoses. We test boost control and turbo condition.

cards.title: NOx Sensor and AdBlue Faults
cards.description: Emissions warnings, AdBlue messages or a no-restart countdown may come from a failing NOx sensor, AdBlue pump, heater or injector. We read fault codes and test the SCR system.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTD Engine: A Complete Later Ingenium Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTD engine is a later version of the 2.0-litre four-cylinder Ingenium diesel, with revised calibration and emissions equipment. It carries a large vehicle on a small engine, so timing chain wear, oil dilution, DPF blockages and EGR faults often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The 204DTD code separates this engine from earlier 204DTA units and from transverse Ingenium engines in other models. We identify the correct Land Rover Discovery Ingenium engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration before any unit is supplied.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a full rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTD engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
